name: intact_get_interactor
description: Get the first matching interactor plus metadata for all interaction entries fetched in this page. interaction_ids is no longer cut to 10 and contains one ID per fetched entry. Compare count with hitCount to assess completeness.

identifier.description: IntAct identifier (e.g., 'EBI-1004115') or UniProt ID (e.g., 'P04637') or gene name

format.description: Response format. Only 'json' is produced by this endpoint.

size.description: Maximum number of interactions to return (default 25). IntAct entries commonly have far more -- the response reports the true total as 'hitCount', so raise 'size' to that value to retrieve them all.

return_schema.description: Interactor information including names, organism, cross-references (returns array for multiple results or object for single result)

name: intact_get_interactions
description: Get all interactions involving a specific interactor (protein or gene) by identifier. Uses EBI Search API (IntAct domain) for reliable access. Returns list of interactions with interaction IDs (e.g., 'EBI-366083-EBI-366083') in the 'interaction_ids' field. These IDs can be used with intact_get_interaction_details or intact_get_interaction_network to get detailed information. Accepts UniProt IDs, gene names, or IntAct identifiers. Returns 25 interactions per call by default; compare 'count' with 'hitCount' in the response metadata and raise 'size' to retrieve the rest.

identifier.description: IntAct identifier, UniProt ID, or gene name

format.description: Response format. Only 'json' is produced by this endpoint.

size.description: Maximum number of interactions to return (default 25). IntAct entries commonly have far more -- the response reports the true total as 'hitCount', so raise 'size' to that value to retrieve them all.

return_schema.description: List of interactions involving the interactor

interactor_descriptions.description: The participants, as IntAct describes them.

items.description: One participant, as IntAct describes it.

source.description: Which database the interaction came from. IntAct aggregates, so the same interaction can appear from several sources.

name: intact_search_interactions
description: Search IntAct interactions through EBI Search. The first parameter is a zero-based offset and is forwarded as EBI start; metadata reports hitCount, start, has_more, and next_start. interaction_ids contains every ID in the returned page.

query.description: Search query string (e.g., protein name, gene name, interaction type)

first.description: Zero-based result offset. Continue with metadata.next_start while metadata.has_more is true.

max.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 25, max: 100)

format.description: Response format. Only 'json' is produced by this endpoint.

interactor_descriptions.description: The participants, as IntAct describes them.

items.description: One participant, as IntAct describes it.

source.description: Which database the interaction came from. IntAct aggregates, so the same interaction can appear from several sources.

name: intact_get_interaction_details
description: Get detailed information about a specific interaction by its IntAct interaction ID. Requires an IntAct interaction ID in format 'EBI-XXXXXX-EBI-YYYYYY' (e.g., 'EBI-366083-EBI-366083'). To get interaction IDs: 1) Use intact_get_interactions with a protein/gene identifier - it returns 'interaction_ids' field, or 2) Use intact_search_interactions - it also returns 'interaction_ids' field. Then use one of those IDs with this tool to get detailed interaction information. Returns complete interaction data including participants, interaction type, detection methods, and publications.

interaction_id.description: IntAct interaction ID in format 'EBI-XXXXXX-EBI-YYYYYY' (e.g., 'EBI-366083-EBI-366083'). Get these IDs from intact_get_interactions or intact_search_interactions results (see 'interaction_ids' field)

format.description: Response format. Only 'json' is produced by this endpoint.

return_schema.description: Details of the single matching interaction record

id.description: IntAct's identifier for the interaction, built from the two interactor accessions, e.g. 'EBI-714308-EBI-366083'.

interaction_name.description: The interaction's name, normally the two participants joined, e.g. 'TP53TG1-TP53'.

interactor_descriptions.description: The participants as IntAct describes them.

source.description: Which IntAct dataset the record came from.

name: intact_get_interaction_network
description: Get interaction network centered on a specific interactor. Uses EBI Search API (IntAct domain) for reliable access. Accepts IntAct identifiers (e.g., 'EBI-1004115'), UniProt IDs (e.g., 'P04637'), or gene names (e.g., 'BRCA1'). Returns interactions with interaction IDs in the 'interaction_ids' field. These IDs can be used with intact_get_interaction_details for detailed information.

identifier.description: IntAct identifier, UniProt ID, or gene name. Aliases: uniprot_id, protein_id, gene_symbol, gene_name.

depth.description: Network depth: 1 for direct interactions only, 2 for 2-hop network, etc. (default: 1)

limit.description: Maximum number of interactions to return (default: 50, max: 200). Alias: size.

size.description: Alias for limit. Maximum number of interactions to return (default: 50).

format.description: Response format. Only 'json' is produced by this endpoint.

protein_name.description: Alias for gene_symbol/identifier. Common protein name (e.g., MDM2, TP53).

protein.description: Alias for identifier. Gene symbol or protein name (e.g., 'TP53', 'BRCA1').

interactor_descriptions.description: The participants, as IntAct describes them.

items.description: One participant, as IntAct describes it.

source.description: Which database the interaction came from. IntAct aggregates, so the same interaction can appear from several sources.

name: intact_get_interactions_by_organism
description: Get all interactions for a specific organism by taxonomy ID. Uses EBI Search API (IntAct domain) to find interactions involving proteins from the specified organism. Returns list of interactions with interaction IDs in the 'interaction_ids' field. These IDs can be used with intact_get_interaction_details to get detailed information. Common taxonomy IDs: 9606 (Homo sapiens), 10090 (Mus musculus), 10116 (Rattus norvegicus), 7227 (Drosophila melanogaster), 6239 (Caenorhabditis elegans), 7955 (Danio rerio).

taxid.description: NCBI taxonomy ID (e.g., '9606' for human, '10090' for mouse). Find taxonomy IDs at https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/taxonomy

size.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 25, max: 100)

format.description: Response format. Only 'json' is produced by this endpoint.

return_schema.description: List of interactions for the organism

interactor_descriptions.description: The participants as IntAct describes them.

source.description: Which IntAct dataset it came from.

name: intact_get_interactions_by_complex
description: Search for protein complexes in IntAct database using Complex Web Service. Accepts complex names (e.g., 'TP53', 'ndc80'), complex ACs (e.g., 'CPX-915'), or gene names. Returns complex information including complex AC, name, description, organism, and interactors. Use the complex ACs from results to find related interactions. Note: This searches for complexes, not interactions directly. To find interactions involving a complex, use the complex name or AC with intact_search_interactions.

complex_id.description: Complex name (e.g., 'TP53', 'ndc80'), complex AC (e.g., 'CPX-915'), or gene name

size.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 25, max: 100)

format.description: Response format. Only 'json' is produced by this endpoint.

return_schema.description: List of complexes matching the search. Each complex includes complexAC, complexName, organismName, description, predictedComplex, and interactors.

organismName.description: Organism and taxon id in ONE string, e.g. 'Homo sapiens; 9606'. Split on '; '.

predictedComplex.description: True when the complex is PREDICTED rather than curated from experiment. A predicted complex is a hypothesis.

identifier.description: Its identifier in the source database, e.g. a UniProt accession.

identifierLink.description: A resolvable link to that record.

interactorType.description: What kind of molecule, e.g. 'protein', 'small molecule', 'RNA'. A complex is not all protein.

stochiometry.description: How many copies are in the complex, as free text, e.g. 'minValue: 2, maxValue: 2'. Present on only 2 of the 113 components measured -- so the composition is usually qualitative.

identifierLink.description: A link to it, where one exists.

qualifier.description: What the cross-reference asserts, e.g. 'orthology-group'. A cross-reference without its qualifier reads as identity when it may be homology.

name: intact_get_complex_details
description: Get detailed information about a specific protein complex by its complex AC (Complex Accession, e.g., 'CPX-915'). Returns comprehensive complex information including: complex AC, name, synonyms, systematic name, functions, properties, species, ligands, complex assemblies, participants (with interactor details), and associated diseases. To find complex ACs, use intact_get_interactions_by_complex to search for complexes first.

complex_ac.description: Complex AC (Complex Accession) in format 'CPX-XXXXX' (e.g., 'CPX-915', 'CPX-10081'). Get complex ACs from intact_get_interactions_by_complex search results.

format.description: Response format. Only 'json' is produced by this endpoint.

return_schema.description: Complete complex details including complexAC, name, synonyms, systematicName, functions, properties, species, ligands, complexAssemblies, participants, diseases, and other metadata

properties.description: Properties and characteristics of the complex

participants.description: Complex participants with interactor details, stoichiometry, and features

crossReferences.description: Cross-references for the feature, each naming a database, identifier and qualifier

featureRole.description: The feature's role in the interaction

featureType.description: What kind of feature it is

linkedFeatures.description: Features on other participants this one binds to. IntAct nests these recursively, so the deeper levels are declared open

participantId.description: Which participant the feature belongs to

ranges.description: Residue ranges the feature covers, as strings like '113-201' - the binding interface itself

linkedFeatures.description: Features on this participant linked to features on another - the binding interfaces of the complex
